reason: Playwright's inspector, recorder and code generator, which Strider doesn't have
Unit tests of Playwright's own modules, run without a browser
Playwright's event emitter, a Node-style implementation Strider doesn't have: its events are Effect streams
Parsers of Playwright's selector and locator syntax, run without a browser; Strider's locators are typed calls
The debug controller Playwright's VS Code extension drives
Launching through a Selenium Grid, which Strider doesn't do
@playwright/test's matchers on plain values; Strider's tests use their runner's own
Drives Playwright's own trace viewer app (showTraceViewer) over traces Playwright recorded; Strider has no viewer, and its traces opening in Playwright's is covered by its recordings suites
Playwright's APIRequestContext, an HTTP client beside the browser (context.request, playwright.request.newContext); Strider has none
Playwright's own client-server wire protocol (launchServer, connect); Strider connects directly over CDP, BiDi, or the inspector
Playwright's code generator: its injected generateSelector and asLocator, which turn an element or selector into Playwright source; Strider has no generator
Client certificates for a context (TLS client authentication), which Strider doesn't have yet
Playwright's slowMo, a pause before each operation; Strider has no such launch option
